title: This Sea Cow Farms Its Own Underwater Meadow
subject: dugong

scenes.text: A sea cow farms its own food.
The dugong grazes one small patch of seagrass, then leaves it alone.
Then it returns to the same patch and grazes it again, and again.
Scientists call it cultivation grazing, a bit like mowing a lawn so tender shoots keep growing.
Researchers have tracked it in Indonesia, and found that dugongs favor fast growing seagrass.
No fences. No tools. Just a sea cow tending its meadow.

description:
A dugong grazes one patch of seagrass, leaves it, and returns to graze it again.

What other animal do you think farms its food?
